To assist you effectively, I'll need to know a couple of details:

1. The structure of the new pilot session rows and the existing measurements table (column names and types).
2. The criteria for integrating or updating the measurements with the new pilot session data.
3. If there are any specific calculations or aggregations needed to generate the `results_summary`.

Once I have this information, I can run the necessary SQL commands to perform the integration.

The new pilot session rows include columns: session_id, participant_id, sleep_duration, and sleep_quality. The existing measurements table has the same columns but also includes a timestamp. We want to update measurements with the new data, replacing any existing rows that match on session_id. The results_summary requires average sleep_duration and average sleep_quality per participant. 

Thanks!
